name: coding-refactor-split-god-function
description: Refactor: split a large function into smaller focused helpers

turns.userMessage: Refactor `src/processor.ts`: the `processAll` function is doing too many things in one 40+ line function. Split it into 4 focused helper functions: `validateItems`, `transformItems`, `computeStats`, and `buildReport`. Keep the public API identical.

mockResponses.text: Split `processAll` into 4 focused helpers: `validateItems` (input classification), `transformItems` (data transformation), `computeStats` (aggregation), and `buildReport` (report assembly). The public `processAll` now orchestrates them in a clean 4-line pipeline. Each helper is testable independently.
